scenarios.title: 2. Index repository context button disabled state with no PR URL
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the 'Index repository context' button is disabled when no pull request URL is provided or API is not ready.

scenarios.title: 3. Analyze change button disabled state when API not ready and no diff
scenarios.purpose: Verify the 'Analyze change' button is disabled when the API is not ready and no diff or PR URL is entered.

scenarios.title: 4. Setup required indication visible when API not ready
scenarios.purpose: Confirm that the 'Setup required' text and hint to configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL are visible when apiReady is false.

steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.
